title: Chameleon eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A9713A'/>
  <!-- tail curling on branch -->
  <path d='M20 70 C14 64 13 56 20 54 C27 52 30 60 25 64 C21 67 18 63 21 61' fill='none' stroke='#3FCB6E' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#3FCB6E'/>
  <!-- body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='18' ry='7' fill='#7FE8A4'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M32 46 L36 51 L40 44 L45 50 L50 43 L55 50 L60 44 L64 51 L68 46' fill='none' stroke='#2AA857' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <path d='M34 68 L31 76' stroke='#2AA857' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 68 L66 76' stroke='#2AA857' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <path d='M62 66 L68 70' stroke='#2AA857' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='52' r='11' fill='#3FCB6E'/>
  <!-- casque crest -->
  <path d='M70 42 C76 34 84 40 83 46' fill='#2AA857'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='49' r='5' fill='#FFE14D'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#1C7A3F'/>
  <!-- mouth opening -->
  <path d='M83 56 L89 54 L86 60 Z' fill='#1C7A3F'/>
  <!-- tongue shooting out -->
  <path d='M88 57 C92 52 95 48 94 44' fill='none' stroke='#FF5C8A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: a little fly/bug -->
  <circle cx='94' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#FF9A3D'/>
  <circle cx='91' cy='40' r='2' fill='#FFD9A0'/>
  <circle cx='97' cy='40' r='2' fill='#FFD9A0'/>
  <!-- grasp detail on branch -->
  <path d='M28 78 L28 72 M34 78 L34 72' stroke='#2AA857' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
